source: Vienna Naturdenkmal register (data/registers/wien-naturdenkmale.json) joined to the city Baumkataster (data.wien.gv.at, ogdwien:BAUMKATOGD). Scope of this pass: the 50 single-tree monuments within 2.2 km of Stephansplatz. The register's other 344 single trees and 368 group designations are untouched and are not repeated here.

leads.why_not_yet: Rathauspark's second-thickest tree at 597 cm, but it is a London plane in a park that already publishes one (vie_006) plus the fern-leaved beech added this pass. Three planes in one park is padding.

leads.name: Platane
leads.why_not_yet: a 1928 plane, 434 cm, sitting exactly in the 950 m gap between vie_001 and the Stadtpark, so geographically ideal. Held back on two grounds: at 98 years it is the least remarkable candidate in the centre, and its address, Dr.-Karl-Lueger-Platz, is the subject of a live public argument in Vienna that a tree page has no business walking into.

leads.name: Ginkgo
leads.why_not_yet: the strongest single lead in Vienna: a ginkgo the Baumkataster dates to 1864, 408 cm around, older than the Stadtpark's. It sits inside '02., Prater - Verwaltung', the Prater administration grounds at Vivariumstrasse 17, and whether the public can walk to it was NOT established this pass. Settle access before anything else. UPDATE (verify pass, this session): the address is now Vivariumstrasse 13-17, a Gemeindebau (municipal housing, Wiener Wohnen), built 1955-1957 on the former Vivarium/Prater-administration site. The complex is described in its own Wiener Wohnen materials as having an "open" layout that "breaks with the Viennese tradition of the closed courtyard form", which suggests it is more walkable than a typical private Hof, but no source found this pass positively confirms public pedestrian access to the tree itself. Register's own address label "02., Prater - Verwaltung" may be stale (the Prater administration function is no longer here). Left unverified per hard rule 10: access must be established, not merely plausible, before this ships.

leads.name: Kaukasische Fluegelnuss, second and third stems
leads.why_not_yet: folded into vie_015. The monument register carries one entry for this point; the Baumkataster carries three stems of the same 1921 planting within five metres, which is what a Caucasian wingnut does to itself by suckering. Recorded here so a later pass does not re-propose them as separate trees.

leads.name: Morgenländische Platane
leads.why_not_yet: Species conflict found this pass (verify session, 2026-08-09): the Vienna Naturdenkmal register lists this as Platanus orientalis, but monumentaltrees.com has a dedicated page for a plane at the near-identical address 'Auhofstraße 11' (https://www.monumentaltrees.com/de/aut/wien/hietzing/15159_auhofstrae11/, browser session, verification use only) recording it as Platanus x hispanica (a different, hybrid species), girth ~4m, height ~27m, measured 26 Jan 2017. The 1949 Natur und Land survey (Naturdenkmal Nr. 178, https://www.zobodat.at/pdf/nat-land_1949_11_0199-0202.pdf p.201) just says 'Platane' with no species qualifier, so it does not resolve the conflict. Possibly two different trees at 11 vs 11A, possibly one tree misidentified by one source. No Baumkataster match found within 20m either (nearest match at 17.9m was a Rosskastanie, wrong species entirely, so likely a private courtyard tree the city inventory does not cover). Needs a pass with a mapped/photographed visit to resolve before shipping; do not silently pick a species.

leads.name: Platane
leads.why_not_yet: Naturdenkmal Nr. 182 (1949 Natur und Land survey, no destruction note, so it survived WWII). No Baumkataster match (nearest live match at 31m was a 2020-planted Tilia, unrelated). Dommayergasse is a short street near the well-known Cafe Dommayer restaurant block in Hietzing; whether this specific tree stands on public street frontage or inside a restaurant/building courtyard was not established this pass. Leave for a pass that can check access before shipping.

leads.name: Four Platanus entries, Meiereistraße 3
leads.why_not_yet: register_ids 3257979, 3257980, 3257981, 3257982, all within about 35m of each other and about 430-460m from the published vie_003 (Chestnut Avenue of the Hauptallee). Not individually checked for access this pass (ran out of window): Meiereistraße hosts a restaurant/dairy building (a 'Meierei') near the Prater, so this could be a public streetside row or a restaurant courtyard. A genuine four-tree micro-cluster worth a dedicated look, since it would sit close enough to extend a Prater-area walk alongside vie_003.

All addresses found (Khevenhuellerstrasse, Franz-Barwig-Weg, Glanzinggasse, Wilbrandtgasse, Hackenbergweg) read as private villa streets in this part of Doebling/Waehring, typical of Vienna's 18th/19th-district garden-villa belt; none checked individually for public access, but the pattern strongly suggests private gardens rather than a walkable public cluster. Not pursued further given the time budget; a future pass could still check each address before writing this off completely.

blocked.name: All 368 group designations in the Vienna register
blocked.reason: the register's ND_TYP field marks these as Wald, Baumgruppe (ab 4 Baeumen), Allee, Baumzeile, Wiese, Gewaesser or Geologischer Aufschluss. None is one identifiable tree with one obvious place to stand, so none is a collectible point. Already flagged 'group': true in data/registers/wien-naturdenkmale.json; do not mine them for entries.

blocked.name: Register entries whose place is a private Garten or Hof
blocked.reason: hard rule 10. The Vienna register protects trees wherever they stand, including inside private gardens and closed courtyards, and a protection order is not an invitation. Any candidate whose address is a residential Garten, a Hof with no public passage, a school yard or an institutional courtyard stays blocked until public access is positively established, not merely unrefuted.

blocked.name: Eibe (Tausendjaehrige Eibe / thousand-year yew, plus two more yews)
blocked.reason: Verified this pass (verify session, 2026-08-08): the yews at Rennweg 12 stand on the grounds of the European Patent Office, not the adjacent Botanical Garden. Vienna's oldest natural monument, called the thousand-year yew, 3.20 m girth, last remnant of a Roman-era yew grove per local sources. But access is confirmed restricted, not merely unestablished: a documented visitor (walterschattauer.eu) was turned away twice at the gate and could only view the tree from about 20 m away. Fails hard rule 10 ("genuinely open to visitors"). The same source notes the adjacent Botanischer Garten der Universitaet Wien (Rennweg 14, free entry, publicly open) has its own old yews as an alternative, worth scouting separately in a future pass.

blocked.name: Eibe, second Rennweg 12 yew
blocked.reason: Same site as register_id 3247596 (European Patent Office grounds, Rennweg 12), same access finding: confirmed restricted, not open to the public. See that entry.

blocked.name: Japanischer Schnurbaum
blocked.reason: BLOCKED, verify pass 2026-08-09 (depth pass, Schönbrunn cluster): Naturdenkmal Nr. 179. Anonym, 'Verzeichnis der Wiener Naturdenkmale (Fortsetzung)', Natur und Land 1949, Vol. 11, p.201 (https://www.zobodat.at/pdf/nat-land_1949_11_0199-0202.pdf) states explicitly: 'durch Kriegsereignisse vernichtet' (destroyed by war events). The LIVE city Naturdenkmal WFS layer (data.wien.gv.at, ogdwien:NATDENKMALPKTOGD) still carries this register_id as an active designation at this coordinate in 2026, which means the city's own current 'official' register contains at least one stale entry for a tree confirmed destroyed 80+ years ago, unless it was replanted and nobody has updated the record either way. No modern source (searched this pass) confirms a living tree at this spot today. Never ship without a dated modern confirmation (photo, observation, Bundesgärten record) that a Sophora japonica genuinely stands here now. Worth flagging generally: a Naturdenkmal register_id existing in the live layer is not by itself proof of life, contrary to how it reads at a glance. Its two neighbours 12-30m away (Stieleiche ND180, Eibe ND181) carry no such destruction note in the same 1949 document and were verified and delivered this pass as vie_021 and vie_022.
